contentFull:
What Fieldays told us about the future of agritech

 
 
 AgriTechNZ News

 

 

 

 
 

 
 
 

 

Kia ora

Fieldays 2026 was a significant week for New Zealand agritech.Across a week of government announcements, innovation showcases and industry discussions, one message came through clearly: agritech is increasingly being recognised as a critical enabler of the future food and fibre sector.This year saw the discussion of agritech moving from a future opportunity to a practical and accessible solution grounded in real farming needs to solve pressing challenges right now. That shift matters. It reflects a sector that is gaining influence, attracting investment and creating new opportunities for farmers, growers and technology companies alike.What also stood out was the visibility of agritech leaders across the Fieldays programme. AgriTechNZ members featured prominently in tent talks, panel discussions, innovation showcases and industry forums, leading conversations on topics ranging from AI and automation to emissions reduction, productivity and sustainable land use.Turning Innovation into AdoptionOne of the most impactful announcements at Fieldays was the Government’s Land Use Flexibility programme, which will support projects aimed at improving productivity, environmental outcomes and resilience across New Zealand’s primary sector. As part of this initiative, AgriTechNZ will provide direct support to the Responsible Dairy programme.Alongside this, AgriZeroNZ launched its Early Adoption Accelerator, designed to help farmers trial promising emissions-reduction technologies sooner and accelerate the pathway from innovation to on-farm impact.Together, these initiatives signal a clear shift towards adoption at scale and create exciting opportunities for New Zealand agritech companies.Building Global ConnectionsThrough our Global Agritech Connector, delivered alongside the UK Agri-Tech Centre, we brought together leaders from New Zealand, Australia, United Kingdom, India and Brazil to explore opportunities for collaboration and growth.We also partnered with MFAT to host Women in Agri, featuring Maury Leyland-Penno, Co-Founder of Leaft Foods, who shared insights on the importance of networks and relationships throughout an agrifood career.The message was clear: strong partnerships and global connections remain critical to helping New Zealand agritech scale internationally.Thank you to our partners, speakers, international guests and everyone who was able to join us for this. It was great to see so many of our members taking part.

Celebrating Agritech Leadership and InnovationWe are delighted to see our members recognised with awards over the preceding months championing both leadership and innovation. Congratulations to the following members:

Scanabull – winner of the Fieldays Innovation Prototype Award

Hectre –  winner of NZ High Tech Awards NZTE Most Innovative Hi-Tech Agritech Solution and Hi-Tech Kamupene Māori o te Tau, Māori Company of the Year

MACSO Technologies – winner of NZ High Tech Awards Most Innovative Deep Tech Solution

Congratulations also to all AgriTechNZ members recognised as finalists across both awards programmes. Together, these achievements reflect the growing strength and global relevance of New Zealand agritech.

Agritech Unleashed: Tauranga

Fieldays reinforced the important role AgriTechNZ plays in connecting innovators, industry, government and international partners to help accelerate the adoption and commercialisation of New Zealand agritech.This role is at the heart of our Agritech Unleashed series, where we are bringing founders, investors, industry leaders and major primary sector organisations together. We’re hosting candid conversations about what it really takes to build, fund and scale agritech companies from New Zealand.Next, we’re heading to Tauranga on Tuesday 25 August and you’re invited!Join founders, growers, investors and sector leaders for a full day of practical conversations, regional insight and real-world agritech in action. Agritech Unleashed is designed to spark collaboration and help locally grounded innovation scale nationally and globally.Register now

Upcoming Events

23 & 24 June: Primary Industries Summit & Awards

13 Aug: AgritechNZ Annual Meeting & Executive Council Elections

18 & 19 Aug: 2026 Institute of Rural Professionals Conference

View all events

Be part of DairyTech Alley

This November, New Zealand hosts the International Dairy Federation (IDF) World Dairy Summit in Auckland, bringing together 1,500+ global dairy leaders, researchers, policymakers, and industry innovators.

We’re exploring NZ DairyTech Alley: a shared, high-impact exhibition space that showcases New Zealand agritech companies to an international audience.

Rather than individual booths, DairyTech Alley (hosted by AgriTechNZ) would offer:

a collective New Zealand agritech presence

branded micro-booths or pods for each company

a highly visible location in the exhibition hall

an affordable entry point (targeting $3,000 or less per company)

This is an opportunity to:

connect directly with global dairy decision-makers

showcase your technology as part of a curated NZ story

join a coordinated national presence at a flagship global event

To help us finalise the concept and confirm demand, please register your interest via the short survey here.

If you have news to share or an opportunity to promote, please contact us and let’s keep building momentum together – turning innovation into adoption.Ngā mihi nui

Brendan O’Connell

Chief Executive, AgriTechNZ

translationZh:
Kia ora

2026年Fieldays展会对于新西兰农业科技来说是意义重大的一周。在一周的时间里，政府公告、创新展示和行业讨论交织进行，一个信息清晰地传递出来：农业科技正日益被视为未来食品和纤维行业的关键推动力。今年，我们看到农业科技的讨论从未来的机会转向了基于实际农业需求的实用且可及的解决方案，以解决当下紧迫的挑战。这一转变意义重大。它反映出一个正在获得影响力、吸引投资并为农民、种植者和科技公司创造新机遇的行业。

同样引人注目的是农业科技领袖在Fieldays整个议程中的高可见度。AgriTechNZ的成员在帐篷讲座、小组讨论、创新展示和行业论坛中频频亮相，主导了从人工智能和自动化到减排、生产力和可持续土地利用等话题的讨论。

**将创新转化为采纳**

Fieldays上最具影响力的公告之一是政府的“土地利用灵活性”计划，该计划将支持旨在提高新西兰初级产业生产力、环境成果和韧性的项目。作为该计划的一部分，AgriTechNZ将为“负责任乳业”计划提供直接支持。

与此同时，AgriZeroNZ启动了其“早期采纳加速器”，旨在帮助农民更早地试用有前景的减排技术，并加速从创新到农场实际应用的路径。

这些举措共同标志着向大规模采纳的明确转变，并为新西兰农业科技公司创造了令人兴奋的机会。

**建立全球联系**

通过我们与英国农业科技中心合作开展的“全球农业科技连接器”项目，我们汇聚了来自新西兰、澳大利亚、英国、印度和巴西的领导者，共同探索合作与增长的机会。

我们还与新西兰外交贸易部合作举办了“农业女性”活动，邀请了Leaft Foods联合创始人Maury Leyland-Penno分享关于在农业食品职业生涯中网络和关系重要性的见解。

信息很明确：强大的伙伴关系和全球联系对于帮助新西兰农业科技走向国际仍然至关重要。

感谢我们的合作伙伴、演讲者、国际嘉宾以及所有能够加入我们的人。很高兴看到这么多成员参与其中。

**庆祝农业科技领导力和创新**

我们很高兴看到我们的成员在过去几个月中因领导力和创新而获得奖项认可。祝贺以下成员：

Scanabull – 获得Fieldays创新原型奖

Hectre – 获得新西兰高科技奖中NZTE最具创新高科技农业科技解决方案奖以及Hi-Tech Kamupene Māori o te Tau（年度毛利公司奖）

MACSO Technologies – 获得新西兰高科技奖中最具创新深度科技解决方案奖

同时祝贺所有在两个奖项计划中被提名为决赛选手的AgriTechNZ成员。这些成就共同反映了新西兰农业科技日益增长的实力和全球相关性。

**Agritech Unleashed：陶朗加**

Fieldays强化了AgriTechNZ在连接创新者、行业、政府和国际合作伙伴方面的重要作用，以帮助加速新西兰农业科技的采纳和商业化。

这一角色是我们“Agritech Unleashed”系列活动的核心，我们将创始人、投资者、行业领袖和主要初级产业组织聚集在一起。我们举办坦诚的对话，探讨在新西兰建立、资助和扩大农业科技公司真正需要什么。

接下来，我们将于8月25日星期二前往陶朗加，邀请您参加！

加入创始人、种植者、投资者和行业领袖，参加一整天的实践对话、区域洞察和现实世界中的农业科技行动。Agritech Unleashed旨在激发合作，帮助本地扎根的创新在全国和全球范围内发展壮大。

立即注册

**即将举行的活动**

6月23日和24日：初级产业峰会与颁奖典礼

8月13日：AgriTechNZ年度会议与执行委员会选举

8月18日和19日：2026年农村专业人士协会会议

查看所有活动

**成为DairyTech Alley的一部分**

今年11月，新西兰将在奥克兰主办国际乳业联合会世界乳业峰会，汇聚1500多名全球乳业领袖、研究人员、政策制定者和行业创新者。

我们正在探索“新西兰乳业科技巷”：一个共享的、高影响力的展览空间，向国际观众展示新西兰农业科技公司。

与独立展位不同，由AgriTechNZ主办的“乳业科技巷”将提供：

一个集体的新西兰农业科技形象

每个公司设有品牌微型展位或隔间

展览厅内高度可见的位置

可负担的入场价格（每家公司目标为3000新西兰元或更低）

这是一个机会：

直接与全球乳业决策者联系

作为精心策划的新西兰故事的一部分展示您的技术

在旗舰全球活动中加入协调的国家形象

为了帮助我们最终确定概念并确认需求，请通过简短调查注册您的兴趣。

如果您有新闻要分享或有机会要推广，请与我们联系，让我们继续共同建立势头——将创新转化为采纳。

Ngā mihi nui

Brendan O’Connell

AgriTechNZ首席执行官
